name: Agentforce Coworker
desc: Autonomous AI teammate built into Salesforce that runs other agents.
desc_zh: 内置于 Salesforce 的自主 AI 队友，能调动其他智能体
solves: Users had to know which agent to open. Ask in plain language and Coworker answers from your CRM and connected apps, or orchestrates the agents to finish it.
solves_zh: 过去得先搞清楚该打开哪个智能体。现在用自然语言提问，Coworker 从 CRM 和已连接应用里找答案，或者调度智能体把事做完。
best_for: You need a renewal risk explained and the follow-up drafted, without naming a single agent.
best_for_zh: 你想知道某个续约为什么有风险，还要它顺手写好跟进邮件，而不用指定任何智能体。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.salesforce.com/blog/dreamforce-2026-announcements/ (the vendor's）。 GA at Dreamforce 2026 on 2026-09-28. The product page adds that it is available in Salesforce, Microsoft Teams and on mobile, and in Claude and ChatGPT through MCP. Distinct from the ledger's Agentforce (2024-09-12), which is the platform; Coworker is the single interface that drives the platform's agents. The same Dreamforce post names Slackforce (GA October 2026) and Claudeforce (beta) as sibling surfaces; both lack their own product page and a day-precision date, so they are listed as unconfirmed in the report. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.salesforce.com/blog/dreamforce-2026-announcements/
